## AuraView v0.3.6

### New app icon
- Updated the AuraView application and shortcut icon with a glossy galactic globe.

### Windows installers
Choose the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** below. Both install AuraView v0.3.6 for Windows x64 and bundle the configured video download tools and ad-blocking resources.

> Note: The installers are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning.
